from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from typing import Any


def scalar(node: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    payload = node['value']
    if node.get('status') == 'ok':
        return scalar(payload)
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {key: scalar(value) for key, value in payload.items()}
    if isinstance(payload, list):
        return [scalar(value) for value in payload]
    if node['type'] == 'Int':
        return int(payload)
    return payload


def main() -> None:
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    work = root / '_scratch/cleanup-control-X8B6/proof'
    source = root / 'docs/examples/cleanup-control-flow.lo'
    binary = root / 'bin/lo'
    fixture = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fixture-', dir=work))
    assert fixture.resolve().is_relative_to(work)
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    def invoke(name: str, args: list[str], expected_status: int = 0) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
        result = subprocess.run([str(binary), *args], cwd=fixture, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30, check=False)
        (work / f'{name}.stdout').write_text(result.stdout)
        (work / f'{name}.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
        records.append({'name': name, 'command': [str(binary), *args], 'cwd': str(fixture), 'status': result.returncode})
        if result.returncode != expected_status:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: status={result.returncode} stdout={result.stdout} stderr={result.stderr}')
        return result
    invoke('parse', ['parse', str(source), '--format', 'json'])
    invoke('check', ['check', str(source), '--format', 'json'])
    preview = invoke('preview', ['run', str(source), '--format', 'json'])
    preview_value = scalar(json.loads(preview.stdout)['result'])
    assert preview_value == {'apply': False, 'selected_count': 0, 'completed': 10, 'failures': ['earlier'], 'last_error': 'none', 'token': 'retained'}, preview_value
    events = fixture / 'cleanup-control-events.log'
    assert not events.exists()
    applied = invoke('apply', ['run', str(source), '--write-root', str(fixture), '--format', 'json', '--', '--apply'])
    apply_value = scalar(json.loads(applied.stdout)['result'])
    assert apply_value == {'apply': True, 'selected_count': 3, 'completed': 12, 'failures': ['earlier', 'broken'], 'last_error': 'Control.ExpectedFailure', 'token': 'retained'}, apply_value
    content = events.read_text()
    assert content == 'first-1\nfirst-2\nbroken-before-error\nsecond-1\nsecond-2\n', content
    invalid = invoke('invalid-arguments', ['run', str(source), '--format', 'json', '--', '--unknown'], 1)
    assert 'Control.InvalidArguments' in invalid.stdout + invalid.stderr
    assert events.read_text() == content
    denied = invoke('terminal-denial', ['run', str(source), '--format', 'json', '--', '--apply'], 2)
    assert 'runtime.capability-denied' in denied.stderr
    assert events.read_text() == content
    staged_source = work / 'staged-selector.lo'
    direct_source = work / 'direct-selector.lo'
    invoke('staged-selector-check', ['check', str(staged_source), '--format', 'json'])
    staged = invoke('staged-selector-run', ['run', str(staged_source), '--write-root', str(fixture), '--format', 'json'])
    assert scalar(json.loads(staged.stdout)['result']) == 'selected'
    assert (fixture / 'staged-selector.log').read_text() == 'probe\n'
    rejected = invoke('direct-selector-check', ['check', str(direct_source), '--format', 'json'], 1)
    assert 'check.effectful-match' in rejected.stderr
    assert not (fixture / 'direct-selector.log').exists()
    report = {'staged_selector': 'passed; one prefix commit', 'direct_selector': 'rejected before execution', 'source': str(source.relative_to(root)), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'compiler_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': records, 'preview': preview_value, 'apply': apply_value, 'events': content, 'result': 'passed'}
    (work / 'interpreter.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
